paper.title: Development of Teaching Materials For Receptive Language Skills In The Area of Listening Comprehension Using Thunkable

paper.authors: Abil Fida Muhammad Qois Al Hadi, Muthohharun Jinan 외 1명

paper.title: Promoting Prospective Teacher Competencies for Designing, Implementing, Evaluating, and Adapting Interactive Formative Feedback Strategies
